1:1: “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations.
2:6: “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.
3:2: 1 homer is about 220 liters or 6 bushels
13:14: Sheol is the place of the dead.
